description: Two glaives and no patience - crits that feed themselves and a cooldown that resets on contact.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 38 real CoA Slayer talents (role DPS). CoA splits Energy and Felfury into two currencies and we have one pool (FELFURY, primary, eleven generators), so costs and generation both land on it while the two-currency interplay does not. Expertise and dodge are live keys only since creature avoidance landed on 5 Nov 2026. Five talents die on 'while Inner Demon is active' and two more on 'above 75% health', neither of which the engine can read.

nodes.name: Azzinoth's Rage
nodes.description: Increases your armor penetration by 120 and your expertise by 12.
nodes._source: CoA over 3 ranks: 'Increases your Armor penetration by 10% and your expertise by 4.' BOTH HALVES PORT, and the second would not have a day ago: `expertise` was read by NO engine code for most of this audit - it reduces a target's dodge and parry, and monsters had neither - which cost Guardian's Stalwart and Gladiator's Double Duty their text outright. Kyle had creature avoidance added on 5 Nov 2026 (dodge on every template, parry on humanoids) and expertise became a real stat. It is in PERCENTAGE POINTS and subtracts from dodge AND parry independently. armor_penetration is FLAT, not proportional, so CoA's '10%' has no expressible form - there is no armor_pen_pct key. Both tripled for the three ranks. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Spite
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 16% and your dodge by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Agility by 8% and dodge chance by 3%.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled. NOTE `dodge` IS THE LIVE KEY: `dodge_chance` is dead data that several talents in this project author, and the same trap exists for parry/parry_chance and block/block_chance. agility_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (character.py:1266 divides by 100) and so is dodge - two keys, same convention for once. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Chaos Soldier
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Azzinoth's Assault and Sargeron Smite by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Azzinoth's Assault and Sargeron Smite by 5%.' PORTS EXACTLY, both abilities, doubled. This tree keys off crits five times (Twin Fury, Legionfall, Demonic Machinations, Oblivion, the capstone), so crit chance is its real currency. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Unbound
nodes.description: Increases your dodge by 15% of your Agility.
nodes._source: CoA level 30 passive: 'Increases your dodge by 15% of your Agility and your hit rating by 6% of your Agility.' The dodge half PORTS EXACTLY - dodge is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and agility in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, a legal pair. The hit half is DROPPED: hit_rating is NOT a valid conversion target, which with stamina has now cost nine nodes half their text across eight classes and is the most-repeated mistake in this audit. A conversion target must name a REAL attribute - 'block' wrote a phantom one for months and silently killed Sun Cleric Seraphim's Clarity of the Heavens. A FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Twin Fury
nodes.description: Your critical strikes generate 10 Felfury.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critically striking with Twin Slice or Annihilan Strike now generates an additional 1 Felfury.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM - only the two-ability scoping goes, since there is no per-ability proc trigger. CoA'S TWO CURRENCIES COLLAPSE INTO ONE HERE: CoA banks Felfury as a 0-5 point mechanic separate from the Energy it spends, while ours is the single primary pool, so '1 Felfury' becomes 10 felfury - half what Twin Slice itself generates. grant_resource routes through the same gain_resource() the eleven generators use, so the cap holds, and its `amount` is FLAT (there is no pct_max field).

nodes.name: Legionfall
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Annihilan Strike.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Melee ability damage now has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Annihilan Strike.' PORTS VERBATIM, chance included. reset_cooldown WITH A BARE LIST is a full reset, as against the {abilities, turns} form which only shaves turns - confusing the two is silent and easy. Annihilan Strike has a 3-turn cooldown and generates 25 felfury, the second-biggest generator, so this node is the spec's engine.

nodes.name: Fel Blades
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 35% chance to strip the target's armor for 3 turns, stacking up to 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Azzinoth's Assault now reduces the enemy's armor by -4% for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.' The debuff and its 5 stacks port. Two departures: the Azzinoth's-Assault scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger), and `armor` on a monster is FLAT - Monster.armor is max(0, base_armor + get_status_stat_mod('armor')) - so CoA's '-4%' becomes -140 per stack, -700 at five. armor is one of only eight status stat_mods a monster reads. 10 sec -> 3 turns. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Fel Instincts
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Azzinoth's Assault by 20%, and your critical strikes increase your haste by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Azzinoth's Assault by 10% and causes it to increase your melee haste by 20% for 5 seconds.' BOTH HALVES PORT, the second re-pointed from Azzinoth's Assault to any crit (no per-ability proc trigger) with a 1-turn internal cooldown so it cannot chain. The melee scoping on haste is dropped: there is no separate melee-haste key, only `haste`, which in a turn-based engine means acting more often. 5 sec -> 2 turns, CoA's 20% kept verbatim. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Demonic Machinations
nodes.description: Your critical strikes open a bleed dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Sargeron Smite now cause the target to bleed for an additional 50% of the damage dealt over 5 sec.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY. Only the Sargeron-Smite scoping goes, and '50% of the damage dealt' becomes a fixed potency because apply_effect cannot read the triggering hit's amount - only bonus_pct, leech_pct and smart heals do, and none of those apply an effect. 5 sec -> 3 turns. A proc-applied dot carries `potency` as PER-TURN damage (30 a turn, 90 total) where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided (abilities.py:2695).

nodes.name: A Thousand Cuts
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 30% chance to strike an additional time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Azzinoth's Assault now has a 30% chance to hit an additional time with your main-hand Weapon.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM - `extra_attack` is a BOOLEAN giving exactly one extra attack, which is precisely what CoA asks for here (unlike Ranger's Tip of the Spear, where CoA wanted three and the key cannot express it). The main-hand scoping is dropped: the engine's weapon roll does not separate hands, which is also why Slice & Dice and Infernal Constitution lose their off-hand clauses. The Azzinoth's-Assault scoping goes too (no per-ability proc trigger), and CoA's 30% is kept.

nodes.name: Pit Lord's Strength
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Annihilation and Annihilan Strike by 16.2%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Your Annihilation now affects 1 additional attack.' Annihilation is a self-buff in our data, not an attack-counting mechanic, and nothing adds attacks to an ability (extra_attack is a proc payload, not an ability modifier), so the node becomes flat damage on both Annihilan abilities. Annihilan Strike generates 25 felfury. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Scars of the Past
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Chaos Rush by 25%, and your attacks have a 25% chance to heal you for 20% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of Chaos Rush by -5 and casting Chaos Rush now heals you for 81 + 20% Stamina + 33% AP.' Both halves port in shape. CoA's Energy is our felfury (the single primary pool), so the cost reduction is real. The heal becomes a leech off any swing rather than a flat Stamina/AP-scaled number on one ability: leech_pct is one of only THREE proc payloads that READ the triggering hit's amount, which makes it the honest way to express 'heals based on your attack power' - and it is the right trigger for it, unlike on an avoidance trigger where the amount is always zero. Folded in CoA's Felguard second clause ('while Inner Demon is active you heal for 15% of all melee damage dealt'): CoA gates this on INNER DEMON BEING ACTIVE. Nothing reads whether another effect is live - the same gap that killed Hard Bargain, Pathfinder, Chaos Fusion and Permafrost on other classes - so the condition is dropped and the node priced for being unconditional. Five Slayer talents carry this gate; it is CoA's main conditional for the spec.

nodes.name: Oblivion
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase your damage by 2% for 3 turns, stacking up to 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critically striking now increases your damage dealt by 1% for 4 seconds, stacking 10 times.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM - trigger, 10 stacks and shape all intact, the rate doubled to 2% because 4 seconds is barely more than one turn and the window here is 3. max_stacks is genuinely honoured even though nothing can READ the count. damage_dealt_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect, which is the BUFF-side companion to the talent damage keys. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: You Cheat, Gul'dan!
nodes.description: Increases your physical critical damage by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical damage by 50% against enemies above 75% health.' CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 75% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA - authored somewhere in this project and read by nothing - and there is no above-health conditional of any kind, only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026. Dropped. So CoA's 50% is kept unconditional, which is a straight buff relative to CoA and is flagged as such rather than quietly pocketed - the alternative was a node that silently never fired. Folded in Annihilan Strike's 'guaranteed to critically strike against enemies above 75% health', which fails for the same reason plus a second one: nothing grants a guaranteed crit on a specific ability. crit_damage_* keys are FRACTIONS, unlike the crit_chance_* family. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Burning Rage
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sunder and Immolation Aura by 20% and reduces their cost by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and reduces the cost of Sunder and Immolation Aura by 20%.' PORTS VERBATIM, both halves and both abilities - one of the few CoA talents in this tree that needs no translation at all. Immolation Aura is a fire dot at target_type enemy_aoe. *_damage keys are FRACTIONS; *_cost_pct keys are fractions too, but POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION, which is the opposite sign convention from most of this file.

nodes.name: Glaiving
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Fury Unleashed and Glaiving by 40% and reduces Fury Unleashed's cost by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt and reduces the Energy cost of Fury Unleashed by 50%.' PORTS EXACTLY (40%/30%), extended to Glaiving, which generates 20 felfury and had no node. CoA's Energy is our felfury - the single primary pool - so the cost reduction is real. Fury Unleashed is CoA's 5-second spinning channel; ours is a 6-turn-cooldown AoE strike, since there is no channelling, which also drops its movement-speed and CC-immunity clauses.

nodes.name: Reachwalker
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Felhoof Charge, Chaos Rush and Fury of the Illidari by 35%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Chaos Rush now reduces the cooldown of Felhoof Charge by 2 sec.' The proc form cannot be built (no per-ability proc trigger) so it becomes a flat reduction, extended to both named abilities plus Fury of the Illidari. Folded in CoA's Perpetual Fury, which reduces Fury Unleashed's cooldown off Dancing Blades - an on-crit cleave that does not exist as an ability here, so nothing can trigger off it. FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn, so stacking these cannot make the abilities spammable.

nodes.name: Felcaked Blades
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 20% of your Agility and the damage of Twin Slice by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Twin Slice and Sargeron Smite now additionally scale with your Agility.' A per-ability stat SCALING coefficient is not something any key reaches - the ability keys are _damage, _healing, _crit, _crit_damage, _cost, _cooldown, _duration and _potency, and none touch how an ability scales off a stat. Built as a real global conversion instead: attack_power is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and agility in SOURCES, a legal pair, so a Slayer's Agility genuinely becomes attack power and reaches every ability rather than two. Plus flat damage on Twin Slice, the spec's filler and a 20-felfury generator. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Whirling Vengeance
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Fury Unleashed by 40%, and your attacks have a 30% chance to leave the target taking 12% more damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Fury Unleashed by -60 sec. When Fury Unleashed ends, you strike all nearby enemies for Shadowflame Damage and increase their damage taken from Sunder by 100% for 15 seconds.' The cooldown ports. THE SECOND HALF NEEDS AN ON-EXPIRY TRIGGER, which does not exist - no trigger fires when an effect ends, the same gap that killed Chronomancer's End of Time and The Vast Infinite, Reaper's Blood Frenzy burst and Painmail, and Ranger's Chasing Death. So the damage-taken debuff is re-pointed to a swing proc and widened from Sunder-only to all damage at 12% rather than 100%. CAREFUL: bare damage_taken_pct is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES - unlike physical_ and magic_, which divide by 100 inside a status effect - so 0.12 is 12% and authoring 12 would be +1200%. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Pit Lord's Rage
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 15% and your critical strike chance by 6%, and your critical strikes generate a further 10 Felfury.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Chaos Rush now increases your Physical damage by 15% for 10 sec. Casting Felhoof Charge increases your critical strike chance by 6% for 15 sec.' Both values port verbatim; what cannot is their per-ability triggering, since there is no per-ability proc trigger, so two short windows become two passives. The felfury grant stacks with Twin Fury so a fully-talented Slayer banks 20 per crit - which is one full Twin Slice's worth, and the closest this single-pool engine gets to CoA's separate 0-5 Felfury bank filling up. Was a pure scalar on our side. physical_damage is a FRACTION; crit_chance_physical is percentage points.
